git_sync: Sync a git repository. Pass repo name as parameter, or leave empty to sync all.
run_script: Run a PowerShell script from the automatiserings-suite. Parameter is a JSON object with script_name and script-specific parameters.
power_aggregation: Trigger hugin-core daily energy aggregation. Runs every 15 minutes and at midnight.
print_news: Fetch news headlines from an RSS feed and print them on the Cashino printer. Parameter is a JSON object: {"feed_url": "https://...", "count": 5, "summarize": false}. Set summarize to true to use the LLM to summarise each article (slower).
print_weather: Print the yr.no weather meteogram on the thermal printer. Leave parameter empty to use the configured YR_ID, or pass a yr.no location ID string to override.
print_today: Print today's calendar events and active reminders on the thermal printer. No parameter needed.
